Label SAE directions with a large language model

Source: R/python.R
label_features.Rd

For each direction w_j, the texts are ranked by their score e_i'w_j; the model sees n_per_bin random texts from the bottom 10%, the middle 45-55% and the top 10% and names what the top texts do that the others do not (Python stage label). With fidelity = TRUE, a second call per text checks whether each label picks out its direction's top texts among texts the labeller did not see (stage fidelity: precision, recall, F1). Pass the training texts: the labels must not use the texts on which the effects are estimated.

Usage

label_features(
  texts,
  E,
  W,
  fidelity = FALSE,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  model = "gpt-4.1",
  seed = 7L,
  settings = list(),
  dir = tempfile("saereg_label_")
)

Arguments

texts

Character vector (the training texts).

E

Their embeddings (documents x dimensions).

W

Decoder directions (dimensions x M).

fidelity

Also run the fidelity test (100 API calls per direction by default)?

dry_run

TRUE returns the prompts without calling the API.

model, seed

Labelling model and seed of the text sampling (direction j: seed + j).

settings

Optional list overriding the defaults: bins, n_per_bin (7), max_words (256), max_label_words (15), temperature (0), n_top and n_lower (50 each, fidelity).

dir

Run directory (a new temporary one by default).

Value

A tibble with feature (from 0) and label, plus precision, recall, f1 with fidelity = TRUE; on a dry run, the prompts (character vector).
